name: [Baseline] - WIN - D - Microsoft Office Shared Computer Activation
description: Lets Microsoft 365 Apps on shared devices activate per signed-in user instead of once per device, so that everyone uses Office with their own licence and the device does not count towards one user's installation limit. Baseline assignment: none by default — belongs on SG-D-UEM-WIN-Shared. Source: Own baseline — Office ADMX, Microsoft Office 2016 (Machine) > Licensing Settings > Use shared computer activation (L_SharedComputerLicensing = 1). Microsoft requires this for Microsoft 365 Apps on devices that several people use..
